baselineComparison.scope: Existing JSEP worker benchmark; numerical inputs/model are identical. Timing configurations differ, so this is not a controlled speedup comparison.

recommendation: Native WebGPU/Asyncify runs the identical full encoder on hardware and is worth considering for performance, but it still violates the existing tensor score threshold on eight of nine inputs. Switching entry points alone does not resolve numerical agreement; keep thresholds unchanged and investigate precision/reduction behavior or a narrowly tested precision change before accepting feasibility.
